name: globnotes
description: A self-hosted, database-less note taking web app over a flat folder of markdown files. Obsidian-faithful links, multi-vault, plugins, white-label branding. Fork of flatnotes. Authentication is set up on first run via the built-in wizard.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Host path for your notes vault (markdown tree). globnotes creates/owns only the .globnotes index dir inside it.

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: User the app runs as. Unraid default 99 (nobody). Must have write access to the Data path.

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: Group the app runs as. Unraid default 100 (users).
